svg.title: macOS · Gallery · the Approved view — one tile per approved output, the pane at OUTPUT · 1310×800
svg.desc: Mirrors the Gallery's APPROVED VIEW on the Mac (2026-11-05, code first — Steven's three answers: the word is Approved, its own row under Library, app code first — signed off on the running app 2026-11-06 and mirrored the same day; docs/approved-assets.md): App/GallerySidebar.swift (approvedSection), App/GalleryView.swift (approvedOnly, approvedAssets, approvedCount; LL_APPROVED=1), App/GalleryGridContent.swift (approvedGrid, approvedEmptyState), App/ApprovedAssetViews.swift (ApprovedAssetTile, ApprovedSeal, ApproveToggle), App/ApprovedAssets.swift (ApprovedAsset, AppModel.approvedAssets(for:)) and App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift (outputSection, sourceApprovalRow, editedClipsSection). gallery.svg's window with the sidebar's APPROVED row LIT: the grid is no longer one tile per project but ONE TILE PER APPROVED OUTPUT, in the grid's own order (the sort and every other filter still apply — the row is a switch, so Library, PicPlace, Tags, Shapes and the search narrow it), a project's own picture or clip first, then its approved outputs. The sample library's approvals, the same in every Gallery mirror: River Sunset to Dusk's Blended clip 1 (t1), Vltava Embankment's Edited clip 1 (t3 — the graded video; its source is NOT approved), the stock clip's source (t5, a video with no edits), _WEX3518 the photo as edited (t6) and one blended clip of t7 — five approved outputs from five projects, so those five tiles wear the seal and the sidebar's count reads 5. So five tiles, at the header's three columns: Timelapse (River Sunset to Dusk's blended clip), Edited clip (Vltava Embankment's render — SELECTED), Video (the stock clip, approved as it is), Photo (_WEX3518, as edited) and Timelapse (t7's clip). THE TILE (ApprovedAssetTile, 4:3 as GalleryTile): the OUTPUT's own picture — a clip's frame, the photo with its look, the source clip without one — a MediaBadge bottom-leading naming the kind of output (Photo · Video · Edited clip · Timelapse · Blended clip for a video's blend · Image · Time slice · Time-slice poster), the holdings pill bottom-trailing (the CLIP's pill for an output — components/holdings-pill.blend.* — the project's for its own picture or clip), ApprovedSeal top-leading 6 in, and the 2.5 pt accent ring when its project is selected (two tiles ring when one project has two approved outputs). A click selects the PROJECT, which raises its pane; a double click opens it; right-click offers Open and Remove Approval. No N clips badge and no selection circles in this view. THE PANE is Vltava Embankment's (the video, t3 of the grid), drawn SCROLLED 381.4 pt — the TAGS header 12 pt under the pane's top edge — so that OUTPUT is inside the window: the three-button footer (Rename · Finder · Delete…), OUTPUT with New clip · Render Edits · Share project (components/output-actions.video), the project's own approval at rest (components/output-approval.video — the source clip is not approved, and its caption says the edits are not in it), EDITED CLIPS · 1 with the render's row wearing the accent seal (components/blended-clip-row.edited.approved — no Open: it is the editor's own picture), then INFO (a video file carries nothing the group shows: Nothing in the file.) and the head of METADATA. The pane's order and rhythm are gallery.svg's PANE REDRAWN paragraph; the hero is this 16:9 clip whole, 302 × 169.9. EMPTY STATE: gallery.approved.empty.svg. Staged with LL_TAB=gallery LL_APPROVED=1 LL_SELECT=<uuid> on ~/Library/Developer/LetsLapseRun/libraries/approved-scratch; measured from that Debug build at 1310×800 through accessibility. The family's known offset stands (a 28 pt title bar and 52 pt header where macOS 27 draws 32 and 54 — see INDEX.md, 2026-11-05).

g.data-symbol: camera.fill + a slash knocked through (no SF camera.slash)
